about.size: Typically 2 to 5 lb and 8 to 14 in; up to about 34 in and 11 lb (NOAA Fisheries). Florida state record 8 lb 9 oz.
about.depth: Adults mostly 10-70 m over sandy areas near offshore reefs (NOAA Fisheries); commercial handline catch mainly 20-60 m; overall depth range 0-180 m (FishBase). Juveniles use seagrass, mangroves and back reefs.
about.behavior: Reef fish found around coral heads, patch reefs and high-profile artificial structure. Often swarms up a steady chum slick. Juveniles use seagrass and mangrove nursery habitat.
about.spawning: April through August in the southeast U.S. (SAFMC); FishBase notes spawning occurs year-round in parts of the range with different peaks by area
about.lifespan: 6 to 14 years typical; up to 28 years (NOAA Fisheries)
about.timing_note: Angler lore: patterns reported by local captains and fishing writers, not tested by studies. Numbers are judgment calls to be calibrated against trip logs.
